caption: The drawing depicts a single handheld wooden object against a plain, light beige background. The object has a rounded handle that tapers slightly before widening into a flat, circular base. Atop this base, a circular disk is attached, featuring a detailed carved design. The carving shows a central acorn motif, surrounded by symmetrical, swirling leaf or branch patterns within a textured border. The wood is rendered in shades of brown, with careful shading to indicate the grain and texture of the material. The base and handle are smoothly finished, with the handle darker at the bottom. The overall composition centers the object vertically on the page. There is a small inscription in the lower right corner that reads “Sam W Ford Del -550.”
title: Butter Mold
